test.authorship: Elwood Edwards (Project Owner) + GPT-5.6 Luna (OpenAI) + GPT-5.6 Luna (OpenAI)

environment.userAgent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/153.0.0.0 Safari/537.36

export.privacy: Diagnostic export may include WebRTC ICE candidate addresses, ports, protocols, foundations, and related network metadata because network-path diagnosis is an explicit purpose of this experiment. Cookies, browsing history, precise device location, and unrelated local-storage contents are not exported.

scheduler.interpretation: Observed library segment lifecycle; not an independent proof verdict.

webrtcConnectionBudget.note: Library defaults, not overridden by this diagnostic. A single attempt can legitimately take up to roughly the sum of the ICE gathering and connection timeouts, plus however much of the offer wait it needs, before the library itself gives up.

selectedVariant.reason: AUTO mode retained for comparison; automatic level selection is not used as strict proof.
